questiontext.text: What is the "Right Attitude to Work"?

generalfeedback.text: The right attitude to work involves commitment, punctuality, diligence, and ethical dedication.

answer.text: Arriving at work only when you feel like it

feedback.text: Incorrect. The right attitude to work involves commitment, punctuality, diligence, and ethical dedication.

answer.text: A positive, committed, ethical, and diligent approach towards one's professional job responsibilities

feedback.text: Correct! The right attitude to work involves commitment, punctuality, diligence, and ethical dedication.

answer.text: Demanding tips from customers before doing your job

feedback.text: Incorrect. The right attitude to work involves commitment, punctuality, diligence, and ethical dedication.

answer.text: Sleeping at your office desk throughout the afternoon

feedback.text: Incorrect. The right attitude to work involves commitment, punctuality, diligence, and ethical dedication.

questiontext.text: What is punctuality in a professional office setting?

generalfeedback.text: Punctuality is the habit of being strictly on time for all professional engagements.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Punctuality is the habit of being strictly on time for all professional engagements.

answer.text: Arriving at work, meetings, and official appointments on or before the scheduled time

feedback.text: Correct! Punctuality is the habit of being strictly on time for all professional engagements.
Incorrect. Punctuality is the habit of being strictly on time for all professional engagements.
Incorrect. Punctuality is the habit of being strictly on time for all professional engagements.

generalfeedback.text: Eye-service is deceitful, hypocritical effort put on solely to impress a watching manager.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Eye-service is deceitful, hypocritical effort put on solely to impress a watching manager.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Eye-service is deceitful, hypocritical effort put on solely to impress a watching manager.
Incorrect. Eye-service is deceitful, hypocritical effort put on solely to impress a watching manager.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are positive attributes that define the Right Attitude to Work? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Punctuality, diligence, and integrity are pillars of positive work ethics. Eye-service is negative.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are consequences of widespread negative work attitudes in a business firm? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Negative attitudes cause errors, bankruptcy, and dismissals. They destroy expansion prospects.
